inputs.<tmp:0>/cache/brigade/refs/shop/<commit::
SCHEMA TASK
	DESC "a change delivered by one pull request"
	FIELD TITLE string
		REQUIRED
	FIELD STATUS todo|implemented
		REQUIRED
	FIELD MILESTONE @MILESTONE
	FIELD AFTER @TASK
		REPEATABLE

SCHEMA MILESTONE
	DESC "the tasks planned for one request"
	FIELD TITLE string
		REQUIRED
	FIELD STATUS planned|running
		REQUIRED

SCHEMA OPEN_QUESTION
	DESC "a fact left undecided"
	FIELD STATUS open|closed
		REQUIRED
	FIELD BLOCKS @TASK
		REPEATABLE
		CONVERSE BLOCKED_BY
	WHEN STATUS closed
		GATE suppressed

MILESTONE M1
	TITLE "Empty cart"
	STATUS running

OPEN_QUESTION Undecided
	STATUS open
	BLOCKS @TASK.S5

OPEN_QUESTION Ruled
	STATUS closed
	BLOCKS @TASK.S6

TASK S2
	TITLE "Remove an item from the cart"
	STATUS implemented

TASK S3
	TITLE "Empty the cart in one click"
	STATUS todo
	MILESTONE @MILESTONE.M1
	AFTER @TASK.S2

TASK S4
	TITLE "Confirm before emptying the cart"
	STATUS todo
	MILESTONE @MILESTONE.M1
	AFTER @TASK.S3

TASK S5
	TITLE "Undo the emptying"
	STATUS todo
	MILESTONE @MILESTONE.M1

TASK S6
	TITLE "Count the emptied carts"
	STATUS todo
	MILESTONE @MILESTONE.M1
